title: Viking landing at Cydonia overruled by an unknown group

tellings.quote: But then in something that was kind of scandalous, the people the scientists running the Viking program who were determining where they were going to land Mhm. suddenly found themselves overruled by a group they didn't even know existed on the project.

plain: John Brandenburg is a physicist who argues that Mars once held life wiped out by nuclear war. On Jesse Michels' podcast he said that in 1976, during NASA's Viking mission to land probes on Mars, the scientists choosing a landing site near Cydonia, a region of Mars, were suddenly overruled by a group on the project they did not even know existed. He calls this scandalous, since it would mean a hidden hand was steering what NASA looked at on Mars.
